notes: v1.27: Auto-return on weight difference with auto remarks. A Mettler scale showing 0.0100 g (10 mili) or more, often returned more than expected, no longer blocks the return — the box closes at once with auto remarks of the exact difference (e.g. 'Auto: scale difference +0.0100 g — returned 100.0100 g vs expected 100.0000 g (returned more than expected)'). Lighter return where the user clicks No on 'go to Sell panel?' also returns at once, done, with auto remarks ('returned less than expected, no sale recorded'). Remarks you type yourself are kept, never overwritten; difference 0 needs no remarks; Yes + sale flow is unchanged (sale first, then difference 0). The final message still shows the difference, and difference + auto remarks are recorded in the report/Excel. Includes v1.26 (startup crash now visible, not silent under pythonw), v1.25 (weight numbers only, scrollable Dashboard + shortcuts help), v1.24 (Space always jumps to table, not Enter), v1.23 (Bill No. renamed to Bill No./Rokar/Book everywhere), v1.22 (Sold column green only when sold, not when Opening = Returned), v1.21 (simpler live rates banner, no buttons, gold/silver only), v1.20 (live MCX banner from mcxlive.org, gold per 10 g, silver per 1 kg), v1.19 (B/Space shortcuts, sale -> Amount, 4-decimal weights, Attendance tab), v1.18 (Box Out horizontal scrolling), v1.17 (Return->Sell notification), v1.16 (return first then sell), v1.15 (version always visible), v1.14 (gold cell, autocomplete), v1.13 (gold row/field/header), v1.12 (horizontal sale row), v1.11 (keyboard Sell panel, Added column, Reset), v1.10 (manual cell entry), v1.9 (table fix), v1.8 (crash-proof startup), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
